BrochureContent.Content:
Blacklion Manor is a well established development built circa 2006 conveniently located directly across the road from an array of well reputed primary and secondary schools. This increasingly popular development comprises apartments, townhouses and larger family homes. The beautifully presented accommodation comprises briefly of an open plan living room, cum kitchen, two double bedrooms, en-suite and main bathroom. 

This first floor two bedroom apartment is exceptionally bright, with a stylish interior and lovely aspect overlooking manicured green open space. The apartment block itself is secure with entrance intercom system. There is access to a roof garden up top with stunning panoramic views out towards the coast. Parking is communal at surface level and underground with direct access to the apartment block via lift.

Convenience is great here as Supermarkets, cafes, medical facilities, and fitness centres are all within walking distance. Dublin Bus bus stop are a 4 minute walk from the development the beach is a 15 minute walk away. Greystones Dart station is only minute drive away and the nearby motorways are easily accessed for Dublin commuting.

Kitchen area:
Modern range of high and low level fitted units with polished granite worktops and attractive tiled splashbacks. Integrated dishwasher, new washing machine and dryer, new fridge-freezer, fitted gas hob, oven, microwave and extractor hood.
